# Vendored GitAscii renderers

These TypeScript renderers are copied or extracted from the parent GitAscii
checkout, `src/features/widgets/renderers/`. They are distributed under
GPL-3.0-or-later; see [GitAscii-LICENSE.txt](./GitAscii-LICENSE.txt).

Upstream: https://github.com/Igorcbraz/GitAscii

- `SurveillanceHeader.ts`: helpers and the header from `SurveillanceRenderers.ts`.
  Original community inspiration: https://github.com/rugbedbugg/rugbedbugg
- `WinXPWidgets.ts`: shared chrome, media player, taskbar and critical error.
- `CodewebShowcaseCardsRenderer.ts` and `CodewebSocialBadgeRenderer.ts`:
  https://github.com/codeweb-dev/codeweb-dev
- `DeveloperQuoteRenderer.ts`: quote card and quote collection.

The artwork was rendered locally with imports and TypeScript types removed,
embedded images and icon geometry supplied, and Madhav's profile copy configured.
The source templates themselves are otherwise kept intact.
